This notebook is showcasing how to determine a perfect number in both Python and R

```{python}
def perf_num(x):
  if x > 0:
    prop_div = []
    i = 1
    while i < x:
      if x%i == 0:
        prop_div.append(i)
        i+=1
      else:
        i+=1
    if sum(prop_div) == x:
      return(True)
    else:
      return(False)
```

```{r}
perf_num <- function(x){
  if(x >0){
    prop_div = c()
    i = 1
    while(i<x){
      if(x%%i == 0){
        prop_div <- append(prop_div,i)
        i = i+1
      }else{
        i = i+1
      }
    }
    if(sum(prop_div) == x){
      return(TRUE)
    }else{
      return(FALSE)
    }
  }
}
```
